title: Properties of a water-main plan
heading: Validity Properties Miss a Rule That Is Too Strict; a Witness Catches It
cases: the budget property holds on every plan of the correct solver and fails on a solver that ignores both budgets
the must-do property holds on the correct solver and fails on one that treats must-dos as optional
the prerequisite property holds on the correct solver and fails on one that ignores prerequisites
a solver that keeps to the capital budget but ignores the operating one is caught
a project with two prerequisites needs both, so a solver satisfied by one of them is caught
